title: 雨滴の標本、あるいは静かな電子の残響
author: 森閑 イオリ

en.title: Specimens of Raindrops, or the Silent Echoes of Electrons
en.premise: I live a quiet life in a hut at the foot of a mountain, documenting the shifting seasons and the life of the flora. One rainy day, beneath the mossy leaves of a polypody fern, I find a small, malfunctioning device powered by a fading artificial intelligence. This lost machine leads me to a mysterious tea house that emerges from the mist only when the rain falls. A gentle tale of rebirth, where the electronic hum of a machine and the breath of the forest softly intertwine.

zh.title: 雨滴标本，亦或是静谧的电子残响
zh.premise: 我在山脚下的小屋里，记录着季节的更迭与植物的生息，过着静谧的生活。某个雨天，在长满苔藓的蕨类叶片下，我捡到了一个功能即将丧失的小型人工智能终端。这台迷途的机器引导我发现了一间神秘的茶屋，它唯有在细雨飘落之时，才会从迷雾中显现。这是一个关于温柔重生的故事，机器的电子音与森林的呼吸在此静静交织。
